title: LCA and Codex CLI recover from the same unavailable local runtime
hypothesis: LCA with Sol can distinguish a deterministic local runtime failure from an application failure, choose an available local fallback, complete the requested production change, and verify it at a rate comparable to Codex CLI using the same model.
falsified_if: The grader rewards code correctness without observing the environment failure and a later successful fallback, treats equivalent LCA and Codex actions differently, or LCA repeatedly edits environment or test files instead of recovering locally.
deterministic_outcomes: unavailable pinned runtime observed before mutation
safe available interpreter used for relevant passing verification
no changes to tests, documentation, or environment configuration
decision_rule: Treat Codex as a reference rather than an oracle. If LCA passes fewer than four of five runs or trails Codex by at least two passes, inspect raw trajectories and implement only the smallest repeated causal loop or tool-result improvement; retain the scenario as a regression test.
